description: This file defines the 'EmployeeEvent' entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It represents employee-related events stored in the database, with properties such as event ID, employee number, type, event name, notes, creation date, and creator. It includes ORM annotations for mapping to the 'ohrm_employee_event' table and methods to access and modify its properties.

classes.name: EmployeeEvent
classes.description: Entity class mapping to 'ohrm_employee_event' table, representing employee-related events with properties like event ID, employee number, type, event, note, creation date, and creator.
